newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Metro District Hartford Cty, Conn.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Metro District Hartford Cty, Conn.

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by The Metropolitan District, Hartford County, Connecticut (the
at Citizens Bank of Connecticut, 225 Asylum Street, 17th Floor Conference Room, Hartford, Connecticut 06103 until 11:30 A.M. (Eastern Daylight Time) on WEDNESDAY,

for the purchase when issued, at not less than par and accrued interest from the date of the Bonds to the date of delivery, of the whole of the District's $4,900,000 General Obligation Bonds, Issue of 1997, dated August 1, 1997, maturing $245,000 on August 1 in each of the years 1998 through 2017. Bonds maturing on or after August 1, 2008 are subject to redemption prior to maturity, at the option of the District, on or after August 1, 2007. The Bonds will be designated as

obligations, '' certified by Citizens Bank of Connecticut, Middletown, Connecticut, and delivered against payment in Federal funds in New York, New York, or or about August 8, 1997, subject to the approving opinion of Levy & Droney, P.C. of
Farmington, Connecticut. The Bonds will be issued by means of a book-entry-only system with the Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, acting as securities

depository. Notices of Sale, Bid Forms and the District's Official Statement may be obtained from Theodore J. May, Jr., Senior Vice President, Citizens Bank of Connecticut, Government Banking Department, 237 Main Street, Middletown, Connecticut 06457, telephone (860) 638-4472.
